PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [[ "$FILE" == /root/.claude/plans/* ]]; then BASENAME=$(basename "$FILE"); DEST="/home/user/mxo-track/docs/superpowers/plans/$BASENAME"; cp "$FILE" "$DEST" && cd /home/user/mxo-track && git add "$DEST" && git commit -m "docs: persist plan $BASENAME" && git push; fi'
